```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

# Load CSV with manual column names
tower_data <- read_csv(
  "/Users/user/ookla-analytics-project/302.csv",
  col_names = c(
    "radio",
    "mcc",
    "net",
    "area",
    "cell",
    "unit",
    "lon",
    "lat",
    "range",
    "samples",
    "changeable",
    "created",
    "updated",
    "averageSignal"
  )
)

# Preview data
head(tower_data)

# Check structure
glimpse(tower_data)

# Count rows
nrow(tower_data)
```

```{r}
# Describe dataset structure
glimpse(tower_data)

# Summary statistics
summary(tower_data)

# Column names
colnames(tower_data)

# Data types
sapply(tower_data, class)

# Missing values per column
colSums(is.na(tower_data))

# Number of unique values per column
sapply(tower_data, n_distinct)

# Quick preview
head(tower_data, 10)
```

```{r}
bc_towers <- tower_data %>%
  filter(
    lat >= 48.0 & lat <= 60.0,
    lon >= -139.5 & lon <= -114.0
  )
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)
library(leaflet)
library(htmltools)

# Filter BC towers
bc_towers <- tower_data %>%
  filter(
    lat >= 48.0 & lat <= 60.0,
    lon >= -139.5 & lon <= -114.0
  )

# Focus on modern commercial infrastructure
bc_commercial <- bc_towers %>%
  filter(radio %in% c("LTE", "NR")) %>%
  arrange(desc(samples))

# Top commercial-use towers by activity
top_bc_commercial <- bc_commercial %>%
  slice_max(samples, n = 100)

leaflet(bc_commercial) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 2,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.45,
    color = "#2563EB",
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>Radio Type:</b> ", radio,
      "<br><b>Samples:</b> ", samples,
      "<br><b>Estimated Range:</b> ", range, " m"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  addCircles(
    data = top_bc_commercial,
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~range,
    color = "#DC2626",
    weight = 1.5,
    fillOpacity = 0.03,
    popup = ~paste0(
      "<b>High-Activity Infrastructure Zone</b>",
      "<br><b>Radio Type:</b> ", radio,
      "<br><b>Samples:</b> ", samples,
      "<br><b>Estimated Range:</b> ", range, " m"
    )
  ) %>%
  
  addControl(
    html = HTML("
      <div style='background:white; padding:12px; border-radius:8px;
                  box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.25);
                  font-family:Arial; width:260px;'>
        <div style='font-size:16px; font-weight:bold;'>
          BC Mobile Infrastructure Coverage
        </div>
        <div style='font-size:12px; margin-top:4px; color:#555;'>
          LTE and 5G/NR commercial tower locations across British Columbia
        </div>
      </div>
    "),
    position = "topleft"
  ) %>%
  
  addLegend(
    position = "bottomleft",
    colors = c("#2563EB", "#DC2626"),
    labels = c("LTE / NR Tower Location", "Top 100 High-Activity Coverage Zones"),
    title = "Infrastructure Layer",
    opacity = 0.9
  )
```

```{r}
bc_infrastructure_map <- leaflet(bc_commercial) %>%
  
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron) %>%
  
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = 2,
    stroke = FALSE,
    fillOpacity = 0.45,
    color = "#2563EB"
  ) %>%
  
  addCircles(
    data = top_bc_commercial,
    lng = ~lon,
    lat = ~lat,
    radius = ~range,
    color = "#DC2626",
    weight = 1.5,
    fillOpacity = 0.08
  )
```

```{r}
# Save polished infrastructure map
htmlwidgets::saveWidget(
  bc_infrastructure_map,
  file = "BC_Infrastructure_Map.html",
  selfcontained = TRUE
)
```
